verdict.rationale: The evidence pack does not document native crash capture for iOS, Android, or NDK, nor device, OS, or app-version context attached to mobile crashes. The only Apple-related item is the RollbarAUL module, which captures Apple Unified Logging entries as telemetry log events. That is an adjacent logging feature, not crash reporting. Generic platform-count and code-version tracking claims do not establish this capability.

support.subject: As a developer, I can capture native mobile crashes — iOS, Android, NDK — with the device, OS, and app-version context needed to reproduce them
